description: Executable evidence that identity links are invalidated eagerly on membership transitions and capability revokes, and that every visibility policy tightening is re-evaluated against current policy before any cached link is returned.

decision_points.requirement: Ban, leave and remove each immediately invalidate the directory, sync cache, invite cache and local profile projection.
A capability revoke that drops the link below its visibility gate invalidates on the same rule.
Existing sessions and device claims fail or degrade to minimal disclosure at the next authorization check.
Tightening disclosure policy or historical visibility invalidates every affected cache against the current policy.
Linked-Realm visibility and Circle effective-scope visibility are evaluated on the same rule, and a link failing either gate is withheld.

cases.name: a_ban_invalidates_every_cache_layer
cases.given: an active identity link for a principal in a Realm is cached in the directory, the sync cache, the invite cache and the local profile projection
cases.action: the Realm accepts a ban membership transition for that principal
cases.observed: each of the four caches and the next lookup result
assertions: all four layers drop the link, not only the directory
invalidation is immediate on acceptance and is not deferred to the entry's own expiry
a later lookup never returns the stale link

cases.name: leave_and_remove_invalidate_the_same_four_layers
cases.given: the same four cache layers hold the link
cases.action: run the leave transition, then the remove transition, on separate principals
cases.observed: the four layers after each transition
assertions: ban, leave and remove are all decisive: none of them is a softer case
each transition invalidates the same four layers
no layer is allowed to keep serving from a transition-specific exception

cases.name: a_capability_revoke_below_the_visibility_gate_invalidates
cases.given: the link is visible only because a capability grant lifts it over the visibility gate
cases.action: revoke that capability without any membership change
cases.observed: the visibility evaluation and the four caches
assertions: dropping below the gate is equivalent to a membership transition for invalidation purposes
the revoke produces no cascading writes; the link simply stops resolving
later lookups never return the link

cases.name: an_existing_session_degrades_to_minimal_disclosure
cases.given: a session and a device claim were issued while the link was visible
cases.action: run the next authorization check after the transition
cases.observed: what the session and the device claim are allowed to read afterwards
assertions: the session either fails or degrades to the minimal disclosure state at the next authorization check
it is never allowed to keep reading the link because it was authorized earlier
degradation is evaluated at check time, not at issuance time

cases.name: a_device_claim_fails_at_the_next_authorization_check
cases.given: a device claim that depended on the now-invisible link
cases.action: present the claim at the next authorization check
cases.observed: the authorization outcome for the claim
assertions: the claim is refused rather than silently downgraded to a stale answer
the refusal names the identity-resolution outcome, not a transport error
no cached claim path bypasses the check

cases.name: disclosure_policy_tightening_invalidates_against_current_policy
cases.given: a link cached under the previous disclosure policy
cases.observed: the cache state and the next lookup
assertions: every affected cache is invalidated against the current policy, not the policy in force when the entry was written
a link that no longer passes the current gate is withheld rather than returned
the interface returns only the identity information the current policy allows

cases.name: historical_visibility_tightening_withholds_the_old_link
cases.given: a link that was visible under the previous historical visibility setting
cases.observed: what the interface returns for historical ranges
assertions: history is re-evaluated under the current policy
an entry cached before the tightening is not grandfathered
withholding is the outcome; a partial or approximate link is not returned instead

cases.name: linked_realm_and_circle_scope_tightening_are_evaluated_alike
cases.given: links cached under the previous linked-Realm visibility and Circle effective-scope visibility
cases.action: tighten each of the two settings in turn
cases.observed: the caches affected by each setting
assertions: both settings invalidate on the same rule as disclosure policy and historical visibility
neither is treated as a display preference that leaves the cache valid
a link failing either gate is withheld
